title: RecipeTin's Hokkien Noodles
ingredients: 2 tbsp canola oil, 2 garlic cloves, 8 green onion stems
Sauce: 2 tbsp light soy, 1.5 tbsp dark soy, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 0.125 tsp white pepper
Garnish: white sesame seeds, extra green onion
steps: Mix sauce ingredients in a small bowl and toss chicken with 1.5 tbsp of the sauce for 10 minutes.
Prepare noodles per packet directions, drain in a colander, and rinse briefly with tap water.
Heat oil in a large 30cm non-stick pan over high heat and toss chicken for 1 minute.
Add garlic and white green onion parts, toss for 1 minute, then add capsicum and cabbage for 2 minutes.
Add remaining sauce, noodles, and green onion parts, then toss for 2 minutes until evenly coated.
Serve immediately garnished with sesame seeds and sliced green onion.
